productOnPage.title: Twinkle Twinkle & Other Lullabies
productOnPage.author: Little Woolly Vision
productOnPage.description: Meet the creator.Ready for bed? Drift off to dreamland with Twinkle Twinkle & Other Lullabies, a soothing collection of gentle folk songs made for bedtime. From beloved traditional lullabies like “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” to playful lyrical twists such as “Hush little baby, don’t you cry, mamma’s gonna reconnect the lost WiFi”, and peaceful original songs like “It’s Been a Long Day” and “Say Goodnight”, each track is designed to help little ones unwind after a busy day. Suitable for younger and older children alike, this Yoto Card blends beloved traditional lullabies with fun, modern interpretations and original songs that the whole family will enjoy. With soft vocals and comforting melodies, it’s the perfect companion for cosy evenings, wind-down routines, and sweet dreams for all ages. Music adaptations and originals written by Ed Hartwell, performed by Gemma Storr and Steve Pretty.Creators brings original audio from independent creators to Yoto: Get to know Little Wooly Vision and check out our Q&A with the creator. Tracks included: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star Star Light Star Bright Hush Little Baby The Muffin Man Baby Bunting Stars Shining Bye n Bye Its Been A Long Day Planes Are Like Shooting Stars Rock-a-Bye Baby Say Goodnight Twinkle Instrumental

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
